notes.title: Alpha Playtest Recap | We Will Be Gods
notes.content:
Thank You for Playing We Will Be Gods!
On May 17, we opened the gates to Hamarvast for the first time. Over two weeks, thousands of players stepped in - and together, we brought the world to life...


🔥 Alpha by Numbers📥 11,000+ sign-ups🧡 9,400+ Steam wishlists🌍 2 dedicated servers - one in North America and one in Europe⏱️ 2.4 hours playtime on average📆 3 Seasons🏆 Top participants clocking up to 60 hours of testing
🏁 Milestones Achieved So Far✅ Alpha Launch (May 17)✅ Global Servers Deployed (NA & EU)✅ 3 Seasonal Test Phases Completed✅ Final Playtest Wrapped Up (May 31)✅ Player Feedback Collected + Analyzed


Huge milestone for us and for We Will Be Gods, and just the beginning of what’s to come. From bug reports to suggestions, your feedback has already made a great impact on our development process!

The final playtest wrapped up on May 31, and we’re now diving deeper into everything we learned.


 ➡️ What happens next?
We will be implementing more content, new features and continuing to develop the world based on everything we learned during the Alpha. A lot of your feedback aligns with ideas already on our roadmap, and your input continues to shape what we build next.

While we don’t have a confirmed date for the next playtest just yet, we’ll be sharing regular updates during the downtime - including behind-the-scenes looks, sneak peeks, Q&As with the dev team, and much more!


🤝 Stay connected:
Join our Discord to follow development, behind-the-scenes and future tests

Add We Will Be Gods to your Steam wishlist

Subscribe to our newsletter on our website for updates



❤️ /Matilda, Senior Community Manager, Cult of the North

notes.title: Alpha Playtest is Live! | We Will Be Gods
notes.content:
The gates to Hamarvast are OPEN!

Sign up here to be part of this epic Alpha adventure!

I signed up - what happens next?
Hang tight! You’ll get a second email asking you to link your Steam ID. A third email will follow with your Steam key.

FAQ:  
🗓️ Servers will be open from May 17 to May 31 (with a slight chance of extension)  
🌍 We’re starting with 1 EU server for opening weekend — more regions will roll out starting May 19!  
🔁 Servers reset weekly during Alpha  
🎮 Stay updated and chat with us in our official Discord community

Can I stream the Alpha?  
Absolutely! Stream, share, and spread the word — we’d love to see your adventures.

Everyone will get to play — invites are just paced!

This is an early Alpha build, so some features may be missing — but what you’ll see is just the beginning 👀✨  
Expect PvE, PvP, gathering, building, and more — with plenty of surprises coming throughout the Alpha.

The team and I will be active all weekend: playing, streaming, and supporting you on your journey through Hamarvast! ⚔️🚀

❤️ /Matilda, Senior Community Manager, Cult of the North
